第92章 不服气林海，陆骁实名举报！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

车拐进别墅区后，林海的话少了。

道路两侧是低矮围墙，树影压在车窗上。

车速不快，门岗看到车牌，直接抬杆。

王桂芬看着窗外，轻咳一声。

“这里环境是不错，就是离市中心远了点。”

林海接话慢了半拍。

“虹桥这边……其实也算成熟板块。”

他说完，自己都觉得这句话没什么力度。

车停在一栋独栋别墅前。

院门打开，保姆和一名管家模样的中年女人已经等在门口。

“林总。”

两人同时上前接行李。

林建国伸手要自己拎包。

林川按住他的手。

“爸，到了家就别抢活了。”

院子不算浮夸。

草坪修得齐，石板路干净，门廊下放着两盆兰草。

可对她来说，这已经大得让人心里发虚。

“小川，这房子……你租的？”

“买的。”

林川语气很平。

“给你和妈住。小冉周末回来，也有房间。”

林建国愣住。

林小冉在旁边笑嘻嘻地补刀。

“爸，哥连书房都给我留好了。你要是觉得不习惯，就每天监督我学习。”

林建国看了女儿一眼。

“那我可能更不习惯。”

李秀兰终于笑了。

王桂芬站在玄关，眼睛从挑高客厅扫到旋转楼梯，又扫到墙边还没拆封的家电。

她原本准备好的几句话，全被堵了回去。

林海站在后面，手里的车钥匙攥了又松。

外企销售一年赚多少钱，他心里有数。

这个地方，别说买，租一个月都够他肉疼。

林川没有管他们的反应。

他带父母看房间。

“爸妈住一楼。卧室连着小客厅，晚上起夜方便。厨房我让人做简单点，妈你别嫌不够花哨。”

李秀兰摸着床边的布料，小声说：“这也太好了。”

“住着舒服就行。”

林川打开衣柜。

里面挂着几套新衣服，按季节分好。

抽屉里放着围巾、手套和几盒常用药。

李秀兰一看就皱眉。

“你又乱花钱。”

林川把一个首饰盒递给她。

“给你买的。别放着，平时戴。”

李秀兰打开看了一眼，赶紧合上。

“我一个老太太戴这个干什么？”

“你年轻时候没戴，现在补上。”

一句话，李秀兰没再说。

林建国站在旁边，喉咙动了一下。

林川又拿出一只表盒。

“爸，给你的。”

林建国摆手。

“我不要这个。厂里出来的人，戴表不习惯。”

“现在不用下车间了。”

林川把表取出来，给他戴上。

表盘不张扬，皮带很软。

林建国低头看了几秒，没说话。

林小冉在旁边起哄。

“爸，挺帅。江城机械厂退休男神。”

屋里气氛松了点。

王桂芬站在门口，看着那只表，又看了看李秀兰手里的盒子，终于忍不住开口。

After the car turned into the villa area, Lin Hai spoke less.

There are low walls on both sides of the road, and the shadows of trees press on the car windows.

The car was not going very fast. When the gate guard saw the license plate, he immediately raised the lever.

Wang Guifen looked out the window and coughed lightly.

“The environment here is good, but it’s a bit far from the city center.”

Lin Hai was a little slow in answering.

"Hongqiao...is actually considered a mature sector."

After he finished speaking, he felt that the words had little power.

The car stopped in front of a single-family villa.

The courtyard door opened, and a nanny and a middle-aged woman who looked like a housekeeper were already waiting at the door.

"Mr. Lin."

The two of them stepped forward to pick up the luggage at the same time.

Lin Jianguo reached out to carry his bag.

Lin Chuan held his hand.

"Dad, don't fight for your life when you get home."

The yard is not flashy.

The lawn is neatly mowed, the stone pavement is clean, and there are two pots of orchids placed under the porch.

But to her, this was so big that it made her feel guilty.

"Xiaochuan, this house... did you rent it?"

"Bought."

Lin Chuan's tone was calm.

"It's for you and mom. Xiaoran will have a room when he comes back on the weekend."

Lin Jianguo was stunned.

Lin Xiaoran was smiling and finishing his attack next to him.

"Dad, I even left a study room for me. If you feel uncomfortable, just supervise my study every day."

Lin Jianguo glanced at his daughter.

"Then I might not be used to it."

Li Xiulan finally smiled.

Wang Guifen stood in the entrance hall, her eyes scanning from the high-ceiling living room to the spiral staircase, and then to the unopened appliances on the wall.

The few words she had prepared were all blocked.

Lin Hai stood behind, clenching and loosening the car keys in his hand.

He knows how much money foreign companies make from sales in a year.

Let alone buying this place, renting it for a month would be enough to hurt his body.

Lin Chuan didn't care about their reactions.

He showed his parents the room.

"My parents live on the first floor. The bedroom is connected to the small living room, which makes it easy to get up at night. I'll make the kitchen simple, Mom, don't think it's not fancy enough."

Li Xiulan touched the fabric beside the bed and whispered, "This is great."

"Just stay comfortable."

Lin Chuan opened the closet.

There were several new sets of clothes hanging inside, sorted by season.

In the drawer were scarves, gloves and several boxes of common medicines.

Li Xiulan frowned when she saw it.

"You spend money recklessly again."

Lin Chuan handed her a jewelry box.

"I bought it for you. Don't leave it lying around. Wear it regularly."

Li Xiulan opened it, took a look, and quickly closed it.

"Why am I, an old lady, wearing this?"

"You didn't wear it when you were young, now make up for it."

Li Xiulan didn't say another word.

Lin Jianguo stood nearby, his throat moving.

Lin Chuan took out another watch box.

"Dad, it's for you."

Lin Jianguo waved his hand.

"I don't want this. People who come from the factory are not used to wearing watches."

"There's no need to leave the workshop now."

Lin Chuan took out the watch and put it on for him.

The dial is unobtrusive and the strap is soft.

Lin Jianguo looked down for a few seconds and said nothing.

Lin Xiaoran was making noises from the side.

"Dad, he's very handsome. He's a retired man from Jiangcheng Machinery Factory."

The atmosphere in the room was a little more relaxed.

Wang Guifen stood at the door, looked at the watch, then at the box in Li Xiulan's hand, and finally couldn't help but speak.
